name: my-testing
description: Project-specific test strategy selection, coverage guidance, and visual QA workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Project-aware testing and visual QA strategy.
interface.longDescription: My Testing selects a project-specific testing strategy before Codex runs validation. It prefers repository-native commands, detects common stacks, and applies the user's Freenet static-site plus local-node wrapper workflow for owned Freenet repositories.
defaultPrompt: Choose the right testing strategy for this repository.
Run validation and visual QA for this project.
Check test coverage and report gaps.
